Senses.Explanation: Chan records place the stump-and-rabbit image in explicitly negative frames rather than narrating an agricultural event. The literal scene is guarding a stump while waiting for a rabbit. Fushan Fayuan pairs stump-watching with hiding among reeds; Doushuai Zhien says a true-colour monk does not do it; Baoben Huiyuan says it wastes mental effort; Yuanwu Keqin pairs it with a ram caught against a fence.
